newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq rises as bargain hunters grab tech stocks.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq rises as bargain hunters grab tech stocks.

text.p: Nasdaq shares posted modest gains Tuesday as bargain hunters shopped for deeply discounted technology shares, traders said.

In a choppy session following the Federal Reserve's decision to raise short-term interest rates, Nasdaq shares added 5.43 points, or 0.44 percent, to close unofficially at 1248.07. Nasdaq shares have shown losses in the past eight out of 10 trading sessions.
The Dow industrials lost 29 points to close at 6876.
"Since the Fed action was what everyone expected, it made people feel comfortable enough to do a little bargain shopping," said Brett Discher, vice president of equity trading at Dain Bosworth.

Intel Corp added 2-5/8 to 133-1/4, while Dell Computer Corp increased 2-1/2 and Cisco Systems Inc gained 3/4 to 47-7/8. Less fortunate was Integrated Systems Inc, which lost 5-3/4 to 11-3/8 after the company said fourth quarter earnings would fall short of analysts' estimates and a key analysts downgraded the stock.
Advances beat declines 2144 to 2096 on 556 million shares.
